requirement: Well-defined theory tuple and observable map
operational_test: Specify X, fields, symmetries, dynamics, observables and initial/boundary data; every symbol and domain is typed.
pass_condition: No indispensable undefined object; observables are gauge/diffeomorphism invariant or tied to a declared operational prescription.

requirement: Closure of covariance and gauge symmetries
operational_test: Compute commutators/BRST nilpotency or constraint generators and verify closure on the stated field space.
pass_condition: Algebra closes without field-dependent inconsistency; reducibility and boundary charges are declared.

operational_test: Evaluate SU(3)^3, SU(3)^2U(1), SU(2)^2U(1), U(1)^3 and grav^2 U(1) coefficients in a left-handed basis.
pass_condition: All gauged local anomaly coefficients vanish or are cancelled by a fully specified mechanism.

universality: UNIVERSAL FOR RELEVANT GLOBAL GAUGE STRUCTURES
operational_test: Check Witten SU(2) parity and any cobordism/global anomaly appropriate to the global gauge group and spacetime structure.
pass_condition: Path integral/physical state space is globally gauge invariant.

operational_test: Hamiltonian/BRST analysis separating constraints, gauge modes and propagating modes around each claimed background.
pass_condition: No hidden negative-norm or overconstrained sector; low-energy spectrum contains the required 2 graviton helicities and SM states.

operational_test: Compute Poisson/Dirac brackets and surface terms; verify propagation of constraints.
pass_condition: First-/second-class structure is consistent and boundary conditions make generators differentiable.

requirement: No ghosts, tachyons or gradient instabilities in claimed domain
operational_test: Diagonalize the quadratic action and principal symbol on every phenomenologically relevant background.
pass_condition: Positive residues/kinetic matrix, real nonnegative frequencies where stability is claimed, and no unremoved Ostrogradsky mode.

requirement: Hyperbolicity and well-posed initial value problem
operational_test: Determine characteristic polynomial/cones and prove or numerically demonstrate strong hyperbolicity with constraints.
pass_condition: Existence, uniqueness and continuous dependence for admissible initial data.

requirement: Unitarity or positive physical spectral density
operational_test: Optical theorem/cutting checks, Kallen-Lehmann positivity for gauge-invariant observables, and pole-residue tests.
pass_condition: No negative probability in physical Hilbert space within EFT validity.

operational_test: Compare matter/gravity characteristic cones, analyticity/dispersion relations and front velocities.
pass_condition: No causal loops or experimentally excluded superluminal/preferred-frame signal in the stated domain.

operational_test: List counterterms/operators generated by loops; run RG and threshold matching; state cutoff and truncation error.
pass_condition: Predictions close under renormalization/Wilsonian expansion to declared accuracy.

requirement: Einstein equations in the classical weak-curvature limit
operational_test: Take hbar -> 0 and E/M_UV -> 0; derive G_mn + Lambda g_mn = Mbar_P^-2 T_mn plus bounded corrections.
pass_condition: Corrections satisfy all relevant solar-system, pulsar and GW bounds and decouple continuously.

requirement: Standard Model gauge representations and interactions
operational_test: Derive the low-energy chiral multiplets, hypercharges Q=T3+Y, gauge couplings and Higgs mechanism.
pass_condition: No missing/extra light charged state and correct electric/color charges to experimental precision.

requirement: Measured particle poles, widths and mixing
operational_test: Match masses/couplings/CKM/PMNS and uncertainty covariance at a declared renormalization scheme/scale.
pass_condition: Global fit is at least as good as the baseline in its claimed domain.

requirement: Lorentz invariance and CPT in tested regimes unless explicitly broken
operational_test: Map all Lorentz-violating coefficients to current laboratory, astrophysical and GW constraints.
pass_condition: Coefficients remain below applicable bounds; spontaneous breaking includes stable modes and a consistent frame.

operational_test: Lattice, bootstrap or controlled analytic calculation of representative spectrum, string tension and chiral observables.
pass_condition: Reproduces established QCD observables and thermodynamics within uncertainties.

operational_test: Compute tunnelling, defects, theta sectors, finite-temperature transitions and vacuum lifetime.
pass_condition: Chosen vacuum is reached and survives cosmological history without excluded relics.

operational_test: Global likelihood including Z pole, m_W, Higgs signal strengths and diboson observables.
pass_condition: No degradation beyond stated confidence and systematics; anomalies are treated with frozen data versions.

requirement: Flavour, CP, rare-process and stability bounds
operational_test: Compute FCNC, EDMs, meson mixing, charged-lepton flavour violation, proton/nucleon decay.
pass_condition: All predictions within limits and observed CKM/PMNS CP structure recovered.

operational_test: Derive composition-dependent scalar/vector charges and finite-range force law.
pass_condition: MICROSCOPE and terrestrial/clock constraints satisfied for the model range and screening regime.

operational_test: Solve stellar/black-hole exterior solutions, stability and radiation; compare pulsars and X-ray/GW data.
pass_condition: No excluded dipole radiation, mass-radius, timing or strong-field signature.

operational_test: Compute polarizations, dispersion, inspiral-merger-ringdown and stochastic backgrounds.
pass_condition: Passes catalog-wide tests and model-specific waveform systematics.

operational_test: Halo structure, lensing, cluster mergers, self-interactions, stellar cooling and compact-object capture.
pass_condition: Joint fit across scales, not a single rotation-curve fit.

operational_test: Evolve background and perturbations through thermalization, neutrino decoupling, BBN and atomic recombination.
pass_condition: Light-element abundances and CMB visibility/anisotropies within likelihood constraints.

operational_test: Run Boltzmann and nonlinear-structure predictions with a frozen data combination.
pass_condition: Likelihood is competitive with base LambdaCDM without hidden parameter/data choices.

requirement: Primordial perturbation origin or explicit initial condition
operational_test: Predict A_s, n_s, isocurvature, non-Gaussianity, tensors and reheating/initial-state transfer.
pass_condition: Matches scalar data and r bound; initial-state assumptions are explicit and normalized.

requirement: Dark matter abundance or complete alternative
operational_test: Compute freeze-out/freeze-in/misalignment/structure history, or modified-gravity substitute across CMB to galaxies.
pass_condition: Reproduces abundance, lensing and growth and passes direct/indirect/production constraints.

operational_test: Predict H(z), distances and growth with stable perturbations and local-gravity limit.
pass_condition: Fits CMB+BAO+SNe+growth at least as well as the declared baseline.

operational_test: Pinned code/environment, tests, machine-readable outputs, source versions and deterministic seeds.
pass_condition: Independent researcher can reproduce every reported number or identify it as sourced input.
